{{Spoiler}}

'''Chorus mochi''' is the meal of [[chorus fruit]]. It heals {{Hp|4}} and grants {{EffectLink|Levitation}} XXX for 1 second, launching the player high into the air.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/chorus_mochi.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Popped chorus fruit]], a snowball, sugar, a [[milk bottle]] and dough make 4. The recipe is taught by a [[Cooking Recipe]] sold by a Journeyman [[Cook]]; crafting it returns the milk bottle's glass bottle.
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating chorus mochi takes 0.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|4}} and gives Levitation XXX (level 30) for 0:01.

=== Trading ===
A Journeyman Cook sells 16 chorus mochi for 1 [[obol]].
